description: The processor has engaged sub-processors without prior authorization from the controller, or the controller lacks mechanisms to authorize and oversee sub-processors as required by Articles 28.2 and 28.4. This includes failure to impose equivalent data protection obligations on sub-processors.
applicability: Applicable when processors engage other processors (sub-processors) to carry out processing activities. Requires controller authorization and contractual safeguards ensuring sub-processors meet GDPR obligations.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of processor contracts, sub-processor lists, authorization mechanisms, and downstream contractual requirements. Requires verification of authorization and equivalent obligations.
